CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_user_has_pricing_role(allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  SELECT (
    auth.role() = 'service_role' OR
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.user_profiles
      WHERE id = auth.uid()
        AND is_active = true
        AND role = ANY(allowed_roles)
    )
  );
$function$

arguments: p_expense_id uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_bank_statement_line_id uuid, p_allocation_amount numeric

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_whatsapp_campaign_counts(p_campaign_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(total_count bigint, pending_count bigint, sending_count bigint, sent_count bigint, delivered_count bigint, read_count bigint, failed_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_total BIGINT;
      v_pending BIGINT;
      v_sending BIGINT;
      v_sent BIGINT;
      v_delivered BIGINT;
      v_read BIGINT;
      v_failed BIGINT;
    BEGIN
      SELECT 
        COUNT(*),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending'),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'sending'),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'sent'),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered'),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'read'),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')
      INTO 
        v_total, v_pending, v_sending, v_sent, v_delivered, v_read, v_failed
      FROM public.whatsapp_campaign_recipients
      WHERE campaign_id = p_campaign_id;

      UPDATE public.whatsapp_campaigns
      SET 
        total_recipients = v_total,
        sent_count = v_sent + v_delivered + v_read,
        delivered_count = v_delivered + v_read,
        read_count = v_read,
        failed_count = v_failed,
        updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = p_campaign_id;

      RETURN QUERY SELECT v_total, v_pending, v_sending, v_sent, v_delivered, v_read, v_failed;
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_fn_revert_bank_alloc_pph()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF OLD.document_type = 'expense' THEN
        UPDATE public.finance_expense_pph_allocations
        SET is_reversed = true,
            recognized_pph_amount = 0,
            payment_amount = 0,
            notes = 'Reversed upon bank statement allocation deletion',
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE expense_id = OLD.document_id
          AND payment_source = 'bank_statement_allocation'
          AND payment_event_id = OLD.id;
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$
